publicationRule: Confirmed official opportunities with a current deadline, or an explicitly open/rolling official application.

scholarships.name: Mollie Davis Scholarship
scholarships.award: Up to $10,000/year for a bachelor's degree or $4,500/year for an associate degree
scholarships.eligibility: U.S. citizens who reside in Yakima County and will pursue a first associate or bachelor's degree full time.
scholarships.whyFit: High-priority local scholarship with an official 2027 opening date and deadline already posted.

scholarships.name: Coca-Cola Scholars Program Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Current Class of 2027 seniors who plan to attend an accredited U.S. college, have a 3.0+ GPA, and meet federal-aid citizenship/residency categories. Strong leadership and service record expected.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Open now; closes 5 p.m. Eastern / 2 p.m. Pacific
scholarships.whyFit: Major national scholarship for students with real leadership, service, work, or school-community impact. The first stage does not require an essay, transcript, or recommendations.

scholarships.name: Washington State Opportunity Scholarship — Career & Technical
scholarships.eligibility: Washington residents pursuing an eligible associate degree, certificate, or apprenticeship in a high-demand trade, STEM, or health-care field.
scholarships.whyFit: Strong fit for students choosing YVC, a technical college, or an eligible apprenticeship. FAFSA/WASFA is also due by the scholarship deadline.

scholarships.name: Elks Most Valuable Student Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Current high-school seniors who are U.S. citizens and will enroll full time in a four-year undergraduate program. No Elks family connection is required. Selection uses academics, leadership, and financial need.
scholarships.whyFit: A substantial national scholarship with local, district, state, and national stages. It is worth applying even without an Elks connection.

scholarships.name: BigFuture Scholarship: Start Your Scholarship List (Class of 2027)
scholarships.eligibility: Class of 2027 students in the U.S. with a College Board account who plan to pursue an associate or bachelor's degree. Save three scholarships in the BigFuture Scholarship Search to earn drawing entries. No essay, GPA, or test score required.
scholarships.whyFit: A fast, low-barrier starting step. Students from families earning under $60,000 can qualify for double entries.

scholarships.name: QuestBridge National College Match
scholarships.award: Full four-year scholarships at participating partner colleges
scholarships.eligibility: High-achieving high school seniors from low-income households; strong academics and financial need.
scholarships.whyFit: A high-value full-ride pathway for students with strong academic records and significant financial need. The official application portal currently says the National College Match is open.
